events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine three days of peace, love, and music. On this day in '69, Woodstock kicked off, defining a generation. What's your ultimate festival track?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away at the age of 42 on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, the world lost a legend. Elvis Presley, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, left us at 42, but his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Death
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur died on this day in 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Gone too soon. On this day in 1996, we lost Tupac Shakur at just 25. His impact on music and culture is still felt decades later.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Death
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 in London, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: The world lost a guitar icon on this day in 1970. Jimi Hendrix, just 27, redefined rock music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. Which track is your go-to from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Rock icon Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today! From The Pretenders' classics to her solo work, she's still got that undeniable attitude. Send your birthday wishes!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo belter?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Release
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was first released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine at 51
angles.copy: A song that still resonates globally. On this day in 1975, John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit UK shores. What does this anthem of peace mean to you?

events.title: Anniversary of the First iPod Release
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Happy 007 Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic spy's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' in 1962. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved actor and comedian John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles Release 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every side of the Fab Four. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: The world tragically lost Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, on this day in 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost a true showman. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
